# install

Copy regular files and create directories with a requested POSIX mode.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/install -m 755 tool bin/tool
moonx cli/install -d -m 700 private
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d`, `--directory` | Create directories. |
| `-D` | Create missing leading directories for the destination. |
| `-m VALUE`, `--mode VALUE` | Set the destination permission bits in octal. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Linux and macOS support new destination files, existing target directories, -D leading directories and -d directories with numeric modes. Existing file replacement and Windows permission application require additional APIs.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md).
